findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: analyze_label · Private data: search_substances, get_substance, analyze_label · Public sink: analyze_label, analyze_label_diff.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: analyze_label · Private data: search_substances, get_substance, analyze_label · Public sink: analyze_label, analyze_label_diff

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
